test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 24 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If a + b = 12 and ab = 35, find the value of a⁴ + b⁴ – 10³?
solution:
**Given: **

a + b = 12

ab = 35

**Concept used:**

a² + b² = (a + b)² - 2ab

**Calculations:**

⇒ a4 + b4 – 10³

⇒ (a²)² + (b²)² - 10³

⇒ [ (a² + b²)² - 2a²b² ] - 10³

⇒ [ (a2 + b2)2 - 2 × 35² ] - 10³

⇒ [ (a + b)² - 2ab ]² - 3450

⇒ [ 12² - 2 × 35 ]² - 3450

⇒ [ 144 -70 ]² - 3450

⇒ [ 74 ]² - 3450

⇒ 5476 - 3450

⇒ 2026

**∴The value of the given equation is 2026.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**We can assume the value of a = 7, b = 5,

It satisfies (a + b) = 12, ab = 35, then,

⇒ a4 + b4 – 103

⇒ 7⁴ + 5⁴ - 10³

⇒ 2401 + 625 - 1000

⇒ 2026
